name: Tukumo 2
source:
The battle of the Tsukumogami is a struggle for souls,
and thus, those souls are trapped in the dark, deep abyss —

Kazuya Kusakabe, who has obtained the power of the Tsukumogami and narrowly won the battles so far, is forced once again into conflict by the gears of fate that have begun to unravel.
Despite this, he remains resolute in his desire to protect everyone.

[Translated from DLSite]
